text:
Chelsea were made to work hard for three Champions League points against a resilient Paris Saint-Germain side but their patience paid off, Veerle Buurman squeezing the ball in at the near post to put them, temporarily at least, at the top of the table in the league phase.
Buurman had stolen the show in Chelsea’s defeat of Manchester City at the weekend, coming on 12 minutes in and nullifying Khadija Shaw’s threat to be named player of the match and she was the hero under the lights with Chelsea doing everything but score prior to her goal.
Sonia Bompastor’s side had been frustrated by Häcken last week, held to a 0-0 draw by the Swedish side and falling out of the top four automatic progression places. There was a desire to put things right at AFC Wimbledon’s stadium and they did just that, albeit in not the prettiest of encounters.
PSG had suffered a 2-1 home defeat to Bayern Munich after three draws and one win in the competition ahead of their trip to London. Denied a point late on, they remain 10th and dangerously close to slipping out of a place in the playoffs.
Chelsea had been thrillingly gutsy and diligent in their 1-0 win over Manchester City on Saturday and against PSG they were similarly solid at the back, but they lacked spark in attack. Ellie Carpenter became the focal point of their forward play from the right, with the striker Melvine Malard injured in the game against City.
Malard was one of three changes to Bompastor’s lineup for the visit of the Première Ligue side, having joined an injury list which includes Lauren James, Naomi Girma and Manaka Matsukubo, with Aggie Beever-Jones leading the line in her place while Nathalie Björn and Buurman replaced Lucy Bronze and Kadeisha Buchanan.
Meanwhile, Paulo César also made three changes, travelling to south-west London without PSG’s injured captain, Sakina Karchaoui, and forward Romée Leuchter.
Nullifying the threat of Carpenter blunted Chelsea, and despite their dominance of the ball, amassing 64% possession in the first half, Chelsea struggled to carve a way through the French side’s backline. They had seven attempts on goal to PSG’s six at the break, despite 33 attacks to 10.
Chelsea have historically performed well against PSG, winning three of their four Champions League meetings prior to this penultimate fixture of their league phase campaign. In the 2018-19 quarter-finals they earned a 2-0 home win and, after a 2-1 away defeat, progressed to the semi-finals; in the 2022-23 season they won both group meetings with an overall score of 4-0. The teams that met in those previous encounters look very different today, but there is a lot of familiarity between the WSL leaders and PSG, with Bompastor and her assistant manager Camille Abily having played and coached against them many times while at OL Lyonnes. They also both spent a season on loan from different American clubs in the French capital.
The visiting team’s first attempt on target arrived after the break, with Merveille Kanjinga forcing a near-post save from Hannah Hampton. While Chelsea still dominated, PSG had more forays forward in the second half.
Erin Cuthbert, Maika Hamano and Lucy Bronze arrived at the hour mark as the home team sought to deal the killer blow their dominance required. It increasingly felt like it would take something special to break the deadlock, akin to the sublime effort that Sandy Baltimore had delivered against City.
Beever-Jones was replaced by Sjoeke Nüsken late on and the German instantly made a difference, forcing a sublime save from Katarzyna Kiedrzynek. The breakthrough came from the resulting corner, and it was far less sublime than Saturday’s effort, Buurman somehow squeezing the ball in at the near post after PSG failed to clear Cuthbert’s ball in.
It was the bit of luck Chelsea needed and they look increasingly formidable.
digest_he:
צ'לסי רשמה ניצחון חשוב ודחוק בליגת האלופות לנשים לאחר שגברה על פריז סן ז'רמן הודות לשער מאוחר של פירלה בורמן בדקות הסיום. המארחות שלטו במשחק והחזיקו בכדור, אך התקשו לפרוץ את הגנת הקבוצה הצרפתית עד לבעיטה מקרוב של בורמן לאחר כדור קרן, שהעניקה להן שלוש נקודות יקרות ומיקום גבוה בטבלת שלב הבתים.

הניצחון מגיע לאחר שצ'לסי גברה בסוף השבוע שעבר על מנצ'סטר סיטי, גם כן בעזרת יכולת טובה של בורמן שעלתה מהספסל. הקבוצה מלונדון הופיעה למשחק ללא מספר שחקניות מפתח פצועות, בהן מלאן מלור ולורן ג'יימס, אך הפגינה יציבות הגנתית והצליחה להכריע את ההתמודדות מול פריז סן ז'רמן, שנותרה במקום העשירי בטבלה.
